name: nexus-desktop
description: Local Nexus capability routing and host-owned execution handoff for ChatGPT Desktop and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Route substantive work with verified local capability evidence.
interface.longDescription: Nexus is a local routing and host-handoff plugin. It uses a read/plan-and-handoff-only local MCP server, exposes no remote endpoint, and never performs execution itself; ChatGPT Host retains artifact and tool authority.
defaultPrompt: Use Nexus to create an editable PowerPoint presentation.
Use Nexus to plan a backend bug fix with regression tests.
